title: Settings
subtitle: Personalize your account, groups, and notifications.
sessionHelper: Sign out of this device at any time.
notificationsHelper: Control how Anymarkt reaches you about results, social activity, and invites.
pushWebHelper: Browser alerts when you're not on the app (web only).
emailGroupInvitesHelper: Email when someone invites you to a private group.
requiredReceiptsHelper: Live wallet bets always email a wager agreement on placement and settlement (win or loss). These cannot be turned off.
emailFrequencyHelper: Batch low-priority social alerts into one digest instead of individual emails.
emailSkipIfReadHelper: Don't email activity you've already seen in the app within 2 hours.
bioPlaceholder: Tell others what you predict on…
manageGroupsHelper: Create markets, invite friends, and resolve bets.
profileStatusHelper: Bio, beta access, and verification status
groupsAdminEmpty: You have not created any groups yet. Join one with a code or create a group from the Groups tab.
privacyHelper: Feed activity, profile sections, residence, rules, and account deletion
showActivityOnFeed: Show my activity on the feed
showActivityOnFeedHelper: When this is off, Discover and Following hide your bets, comments, and posts. Profile sections use their own settings.
showOpenBets: Show open bets on my profile
showOpenBetsHelper: When this is off, other people do not see your open bets. You still see them.
showResultsHelper: When this is off, other people do not see settled bets. You still see them.
showActivityLogsHelper: When this is off, other people do not see your profile activity. Discover and Following use the feed setting above.
showVerifiedBadgeHelper: A badge only, after verification. Documents and personal details stay private.
channelPushHelper: Browser alerts when you're away (web only).
channelEmailHelper: Messages sent to your account email.
emailMasterHelper: Master switch for all email notifications.
inAppMasterHelper: Master switch for in-app notification inbox.
groupDiscoverableHint: When off, only people with an invite code can join.
groupShowOnProfileHint: When on, this group appears on your public profile.
